description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is hiring a Software Engineer to develop capabilities for the Spacemesh Controller team and space-based mesh networking programs. The role supports software design, development, verification, and critical test preparation and events.
Early-career Software Engineer supporting software design, development, verification, and critical test preparation and events

Responsibilities:
• The responsibilities include supporting software design, development, and verification activities using the best software development practices as well as supporting critical test preparation and events that will occur in the Bethesda, MD facilities

Requirements:
• Bachelors degree from an accredited college in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
• Software development experience in C++, Linux, and Python
• Ability to obtain a US government Security clearance of Secret or higher

Preferred:
• Ability to develop and apply strong communication skills within a team-focused development environment
• Familiarity with requirements definition processes and documentation
• Understanding of network protocols (e.g., TCP/IP/ UDP) and packet-forwarding concepts
• Familiarity with Interface Control Document (ICD) definitions
• Exposure to satellite communication software domains and related architecture patterns
